divergences.desktop: buildLayoutJson always emits imageWidth/imageHeight (0 when unset) and imageFilter/filterColor (parameter defaults "none"/"#7c3aed"); the browser's undefined-valued forced keys drop out in JSON
divergences.mcp: `lines` is always emitted (no skip_serializing_if), so an empty layout round-trips to {"lines":[]} instead of {}
divergences.pystencil: has no undefined — missing dims parse as 0 and export as 0 ({imageWidth:0, imageHeight:0, lines:[]})

divergences.desktop: always emits imageFilter/filterColor (defaults "none"/"#7c3aed"); the browser omits absent filter fields
cropRect key drift resolved in Phase 6: desktop writes the canonical {x,y,w,h} and reads both spellings ({width,height} legacy, canonical wins)
divergences.cli: filter key drift resolved in Phase 6: the cli reads both top-level keys (canonical "imageFilter" wins over legacy "filter") — this payload's imageFilter "bw" is honoured; filterColor still has no cli representation
divergences.mcp: reads/writes the canonical imageFilter (legacy `filter` read-only) and the pageSize/customPageWidth/customPageHeight trio, but Layout has no filterColor/cropRect/rotationQuarters/allowFormulas/formulaX/formulaY — those six export fields silently drop on round-trip

divergences.desktop: its builder takes no session fields at all (they cannot leak); only the always-emitted imageFilter/filterColor defaults differ from the browser payload

omits WHEN-DEFAULT rather than when-absent: explicit falsy rotationQuarters 0 / customPageWidth 0 / allowFormulas false / formulaX "" are dropped where the browser still exports them; imageFilter "" passes through, filterColor default rides along
divergences.mcp: imageFilter "" and customPageWidth 0 survive; the other falsy exported fields (rotationQuarters 0, allowFormulas false, formulaX "") are invisible to mcp's Layout and vanish on round-trip

divergences.desktop: null optionals map to absent-parameter defaults (omitted as the browser omits them); only the always-emitted imageFilter/filterColor defaults differ
lines never pass through: linesFromJson->lineToJson re-materializes core::Line, dropping unknown keys ("junk") and non-numeric thickness "9" -> default 2; browser exports the live array by reference
divergences.cli: thickness "9" (numeric string) -> cli default 2; the unknown "junk" key is ignored on read
divergences.mcp: serde Line is strict — thickness "9" (string) is a type error, so the whole layout is rejected instead of passing lines through unsanitized
divergences.pystencil: always re-parses lines (unknown 'junk' key dropped, thickness '9' coerced to 9, defaults filled) — the same-reference assertion has no pystencil equivalent
